transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because I've been having these intense thoughts that people are constantly watching and trying to harm me. I also keep feeling like random things on the TV or on the street are secret messages meant just for me. It's been happening for a while now and I just don't know what to do.
Along with these thoughts, have you been experiencing significant changes in your mood, such as feeling very down and depressed, or unusually high and energetic?

Yes, I've actually experienced both of those extremes. I had a period of about four months where I felt incredibly down, depressed, and completely lost all my motivation. But at another time, for about two months, I felt unusually high, euphoric, and just bursting with energy.
Did you ever experience those paranoid thoughts or secret messages during times when your mood was completely normal, meaning you were neither depressed nor unusually energetic?

Yes, actually. There was a period of about two or three weeks where my mood felt completely stable and normal, but those scary thoughts and messages still didn't go away. It was really confusing because my energy was fine, but I still felt like I was being watched.
How long in total have you been experiencing these thoughts of being watched and finding secret messages?
I've been dealing with those thoughts of being watched and seeing secret messages for about five months now. They have been pretty constant throughout that entire time.

Yes, they definitely happened at the same time. When I was feeling extremely energetic, those thoughts about being watched and getting secret messages were actually at their worst. But as I mentioned, they also stuck around even during the weeks when my mood had completely leveled out.

{
  "category": "differential_point",
  "subcategory": "temporal_relationship",
  "question": "Did these periods of depression and high energy occur only within

No, they didn't only happen during those mood swings. There was a period of about two weeks where my mood was completely normal, but I was still experiencing those intense thoughts and delusions. So those symptoms definitely occurred even when I wasn't feeling depressed or highly energetic.

{
  "category": "differential_point",
  "subcategory": "temporal_relationship",
  "question": "Over the entire time you have been dealing with these struggles, would you

In total, I've been dealing with all of these struggles for about 1 year and 4 months. My high-energy phases and depressive phases often overlapped with the paranoid thoughts, though those thoughts also occurred completely on their own for at least two weeks. Looking back, those high-energy, manic moods have definitely made up a large portion of the overall time I've been unwell.

You mentioned dealing with these struggles for about 1 year and 4 months in total. During this entire period, would you say your very high or very low moods lasted for more than half of that total time, or was it less than half?

Yes, definitely. Looking back at the entire year and four months, those high-energy moods lasted for more than half of that total time. It really feels like I've been in that manic state for the majority of the period.
